I also noticed your automated reminder emailed us twice about the same due date, so if an assistant is handling the chase emails please have it point at the corrected figure once you confirm. Nothing urgent, we'll release payment as soon as the quantity lines up.

Subject: Notes before the review conversation

Hi Owen, thanks for putting the packet together for Tomas's mid-year review. I've read the summary and the peer comments; both look balanced, and I think the section on the migration project is fair to him.

One thing before we meet: Tomas asked whether the review tool's summary is generated automatically or written by hand. As far as I know it's drafted by an assistant from the written comments and then edited by the manager, so I'd tell him it's assisted rather than automatic.

On ratings, I'd keep him at Meets Expectations for now. He's had a strong six months but the delivery slip in April is worth naming once, not twice.

No need to reply tonight. We can walk through the rest in the room on Thursday.

intent.requested_action: review notes and discuss on Thursday
